subject: general
question: In June 2020, launched ‘Suraksha Salary Account’ for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) to enable them to make cashless payments and provide a financial security blanket to their employees.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Airtel Payments Bank**__.

__
 
• **In June 2020, Airtel Payments Bank launched ‘Suraksha Salary Account’ for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) to enable them to make cashless payments and provide a financial security blanket to their employees**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Airtel Payments Bank **announced the launch of 'Suraksha Salary Account', a salary account for MSMEs.
 
• With this initiative, Airtel Payments Bank helps businesses pay salaries to employees in a timely and convenient manner and also maintains records digitally for future references and tax procedures.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Airtel Payments Bank Limited**

 
 
• Founded 2017
 
• Headquarters New Delhi, India
